Subject: Quick follow up: SOC2, DPA, and SCC modules

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the demo this morning. A couple of compliance items came up on our side as we evaluate Redwood for serving PHI-adjacent telemetry and patient-facing triage content:

1) SOC 2: Can you share the latest SOC 2 Type II attestation and confirm the report period?
2) GDPR / DPA: Our legal team needs a DPA — specifically we need to understand which SCC module you plan to adopt (controller-controller / controller-processor / processor-processor mapping).
3) Vendor security questionnaire: Are you able to kick off a security questionnaire (we use a short OneTrust/CSVQ) and provide a named contact?

High-level constraints: MediNova will be the data controller for patient data; we need to confirm Redwood's role for logging, telemetry, and optional model telemetry. Also, please flag whether HIPAA BAA discussion is needed (we can scope PHI later).

Can you send the SOC2 attestation and a draft DPA? A short next-steps note is helpful so our GC can triage.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Security & Compliance
MediNova Health

Hi Daniel —

Great speaking this morning — appreciate the clear requirements. Per your ask, I’m attaching our SOC 2 Type II attestation (2025) and our standard DPA template. High level answers to your bullets:

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (Security) covering 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Attestation attached; full report available under NDA — happy to run a secure link if MediNova prefers.

2) DPA / SCC module: By default Redwood operates as a processor for customer data (customer is controller). For EU transfers we support the standard SCCs with the Processor-to-Controller module (the Controller-Processor appendix). We also offer the modular SCC approach if your legal team prefers picking specific modules. I recommend the Processor-Controller module for MediNova given you retain primary control of patient records; we’ll map subprocessing for telemetry.

3) Vendor questionnaire: Happy to kick this off — I can send a completed OneTrust export and create a shared Doc for any gaps. Please confirm your preferred intake (OneTrust link vs uploaded CSV). Primary security contact at Redwood is Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com). Legal contact for DPA redlines is Monica Patel.

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll route the SOC2 attestation and DPA template now (attached).
- Rishi and Monica to review any technical/contract items and propose a short comment set.
- MediNova to confirm whether modular SCC selection is desired or if the Processor-Controller appendix is acceptable.
- If HIPAA/BAA is in scope, flag that and we’ll loop in our compliance team.

If that aligns, I’ll forward to our security and legal leads for formal intake.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Priyom Das

I can have the completed questionnaire and a short comment set on the DPA by tomorrow EOD. Monica — if you can provide any pre-clears (e.g., retention caps we accept), that will speed negotiation.

Rishi
